L11·N11296unmasked layer
This is a weak, low-selectivity neuron that fires in repetitive product-spec/listing boilerplate (SEO-style keyword strings, model numbers, warranty/size specs), peaking on the whitespace or filler token immediately preceding a numeral (e.g. "OpenStage 80", "Warranty 3 Days", "220g"), with the same context sometimes driving it strongly negative — so it marks a structural slot before numbers rather than any consistent semantic concept.
